title: Product formation and substrate-dependent selectivity in a light-driven diene reaction
difficulty_reasons: A connected formation account must be related to both regioselectivity and alkene geometry, not merely to a single structure or energy.
Two precisely identified diene systems have related but different reaction environments; model-to-observation comparisons require scientific judgment.
Real execution, chemical validity and uncertainty must distinguish evidence-supported conclusions from plausible hypotheses.
